$comment: Localization overlay for src/manifest.json. build.js applies the selected language over the source manifest; anything not listed here falls back to the source value.

description.zh: 手持抖动：噪声驱动的位移 + 旋转（可开 X/Y/Z 三轴）、频率与平滑度可调、8 采样运动模糊、拼贴边缘。像素级效果，不写图层变换属性。
description.en: Handheld camera shake: noise-driven translation plus rotation (optional X/Y/Z three-axis), adjustable rate and smoothness, 8-sample motion blur and tiled edges. A pixel-level effect that never writes the layer transform properties.
